title: I WAKE UP WITH PURPOSE AND FINISH WITH PRIDE

alt_text: A gold frequency ring glows around the NDCH arch-and-Y emblem on black stone veined with gold, under the title I WAKE UP WITH PURPOSE AND FINISH WITH PRIDE, NDCH FREQ 006. The picture pushes in slowly and the gold breathes brighter while one line repeats: I wake up with purpose and finish with pride.

location.name: Panathenaic Stadium
location.why: The finish line of the Athens Marathon, the race named for a run that began with a purpose and ended in pride. First Monday of the year.
